name: Puebla de la Sierra (Spain)
description: Green field with a yellow band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Puebla de la Sierra (a crown and the date 1497 on green, a leaf on yellow and mountains).
history: Municipal flag of Puebla de la Sierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
